project: VALEXII.AI — Commercial Pilot Convergence, Financial Recovery Precision & Audit Readiness
implemented_capabilities: Full Towing Revenue Recovery lifecycle (Dispatch -> Contract -> Rate -> Expected Charge -> Invoice -> Payment -> Deposit -> Finding -> Review -> Recovery)

10 towing financial recovery scenarios evaluated deterministically (unbilled tow, contracted rate mismatch, unbilled storage days, after-hours surcharge, motor-club short pay, duplicate invoice, missing deposit, contract amendment/effective date, disputed charges, confirmed payment recovery)
Reproducible audit package generator (AuditPackageGenerator) with source-linked document inventory, expiration checks, FMCSA/DOT compliance rules, and SHA-256 manifests
Expanded SQLite persistence (dispater_runs, dispater_findings, dispater_audit_packages) with WAL mode and foreign key constraints
Fail-closed tenant authorization and raw ASGI BodyLimitMiddleware 5MB ceiling
Executive Command Center and Reconciliation Console integrated on route /dispater with XAELI 5-step format (NOW, CHANGED, NEXT, WHY, PROOF)
Server-only proxy bridge with zero credential leakage to browser
remaining_blockers: 1. Production merge into main requires explicit human Product Owner authorization.
2. Live customer pilot requires signed agreement and field telematics integration.
recommended_next_engineering_operation: Product owner review and merge of the candidate branch into main.
